## Use Zenbones Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Zenbones Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Zenbones Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Zenbones Mono coding font

A custom version based on Iosevka, inspired by Pragmata Pro. Zenbones Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Zenbones Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 15 CodeFont Top Picks.

## Zenbones Mono FAQ

### Is Zenbones Mono free?

Yes. Zenbones Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Zenbones Mono support ligatures?

No. Zenbones Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Zenbones Mono?

Zenbones Mono is available from Official Website and GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
